name: Pituicytoma
aliases: Spindle cell oncocytoma of the pituitary gland

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO Classification of Tumors of the Central Nervous System (2021)

criteria.description: Presence of spindle-shaped pituicytes with oncocytic features on histopathological examination
Positive immunoreactivity for TTF-1 (thyroid transcription factor-1) and S100 protein
Well-circumscribed, solid sellar or suprasellar mass on MRI without cystic or hemorrhagic components

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation with characteristic spindle cell morphology and positive TTF-1 immunostaining
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires surgical biopsy or resection; imaging alone is insufficient.

occasional.symptomName: Decreased response to growth hormone stimulation test

laboratory: Hormonal profile showing hypopituitarism (low ACTH, TSH, LH/FSH)
Elevated serum prolactin due to stalk effect
imaging: MRI showing well-circumscribed, solid sellar/suprasellar mass with iso- to hypointense T1 signal and homogeneous contrast enhancement
No cystic or hemorrhagic components typically present
genetic: No recurrent genetic mutations identified; sporadic tumor
other: Immunohistochemistry positive for TTF-1 and S100 protein

distinguishingFeatures: Pituitary adenomas often secrete hormones causing clinical syndromes
Different histopathology lacking spindle cell morphology
Variable MRI features including cystic changes
Typically cystic with calcifications on imaging
Histology shows adamantinomatous or papillary features

redFlags: Signs of increased intracranial pressure (severe headache, vomiting)
Sudden neurological deterioration suggestive of pituitary apoplexy
references: Louis DN, Perry A, Wesseling P, et al. WHO Classification of Tumors of the Central Nervous System, 5th Edition. IARC; 2021.
Freda PU, Post KD. Clinical review: Diagnosis and management of pituitary tumors. J Clin Endocrinol Metab. 2001;86(6): 2431-2440.
Liu Y, Wang Y, Wang Y, et al. Pituicytoma: A clinicopathological and radiological study of 11 cases. Oncol Lett. 2018;15(4): 4899-4906.
